description: Expand and compress IPv6 addresses, see their type, convert MAC addresses to EUI-64 and back, and get the ip6.arpa name. Inputs – address: IPv6 address or MAC address; prefix: Prefix for EUI-64 (optional). Results include plain-English findings with fixes and a shareable link.

address.description: IPv6 address or MAC address (e.g. 2001:db8::1 or 00:1a:2b:3c:4d:5e)

name: ipv6_tools
title: IPv6 address tools
